name: Jorah Annison
summary: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Jorah Annison guides warlocks seeking ancient knowledge. The Forsaken cartographer knows both the land and the old texts they seek.

sections.title: A Scholar of Darkened Lands
sections.body: Jorah Annison makes maps in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, though the work does little to hold his interest. He would trade every map in the shop for one good book. Few know more about ancient texts, and warlocks share his taste for a scholar's work.

sections.title: The Cabal's Trail
sections.body: Warlocks seeking the elusive Tome of the Cabal are often sent to Jorah Annison. His knowledge reaches beyond the ruins of Lordaeron, and he can point them toward places where ancient texts and remnants of dark sects may be found. He joins the study of old lore to the geography of distant lands.

faq.answer: Jorah Annison is an undead cartographer in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He helps Horde travelers learn the geography and history of distant places.

faq.q: Where can I find Jorah Annison?
faq.answer: You can find Jorah Annison in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, beneath the ruins of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need to speak with him?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan sends warlocks seeking the ancient Tome of the Cabal to Jorah, whose knowledge of ancient texts exceeds that of anyone Strahad knows. Jorah points them toward the tome's lost halves, rumored to be with the centaur of Thousand Needles and lost in transit on the coast west of Southshore.

faq.q: What faction does Jorah Annison belong to?
faq.answer: Jorah Annison belongs to the Forsaken and is loyal to the Horde. He serves his people from their capital city.

faq.q: Does Jorah Annison sell maps directly to players?
faq.answer: Jorah Annison mainly advises travelers about forgotten landmarks rather than selling goods directly.

faq.q: Is Jorah Annison ever found outside the Undercity?
faq.answer: Jorah Annison remains in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. His mapmaking and guidance concern distant places such as the Barrens.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you can turn to Jorah for directions to the lost pages of the Tome of the Cabal.
As an undead, you share Jorah's home in the Undercity. His cartography helps the Forsaken survive.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Jorah's mapmaking knowledge to navigate unfamiliar lands and recover valuable relics.
